through its `collectorBaseUrl` setting."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it provides"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- `wechat_collector_runtime` — inspect, explicitly install, start, stop, or

- `wechat_collector_login` — start or inspect local QR login; QR image data is
confined to th"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e loopback panel route.
- `wechat_collector_account` — search, add, list, or remove tracked accounts"},{"id":"p15s4","text":".
- `wechat_collector_crawl` — start collection, manage its daily schedule, and tune the request pac"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ing policy (per-account/per-page delays, jitter, freq-control cooldown).
- `wechat_collector_credent"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ials` — list, switch, or remove stored credential profiles; profiles are created only by QR login an"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"d never expose token/cookie.
- `wechat_collector_sources` — manage external sources (article RSS, po"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"dcast, Bilibili); article RSS acts as a second water source that keeps updating while the official-a"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"ccount API is rate limited.
- `wechat_collector_items` — read recent source candidates and previews."},{"id":"p15s10","text":"
- `wechat_collector_feedback` — write a real human decision back to the source
item.
- `wechat_coll"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"ector_analysis_config` — inspect the secret-safe analysis setup or

- `studio_wechat_collect` — compatibility entry for the ContentStudio workflow."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The panel also exposes the normal path: install/start → QR login → add account
→ collect → configure"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" DeepSeek → select account and analysis skill → review the
report → import source cards."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Credential profiles and rate-limit protection"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Each QR login stores the credential as a named profile that can be switched at
any time from the pan"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"el or tools; the active profile cannot be deleted and
credential values never enter DSH. Crawling fo"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"llows a configurable pace (20s
between accounts and 8s between pages by default, with jitter). When "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"WeChat
returns freq control, the run stops immediately and enters a configurable
cooldown during whi"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"ch manual and scheduled crawls are rejected (HTTP 429), so
repeated requests cannot aggravate the pe"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" scheduled crawls are rejected (HTTP 429), so
repeated requests cannot aggravate the penalty window."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## External sources (second water source)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The runtime supports `rss_feed` article sources: any article RSS/Atom feed
(typically a local WeWe R"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"SS subscription for WeChat official accounts) enters
the unified content pool as regular account art"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"icles and shares the same
pipeline. While the official-account API is rate limited, this source keep"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"s
updating independently; the two sources back each other up."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Setting up WeWe RSS as the second water source (optional)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The `rss_feed` capability ships with the plugin, but you bring your own feeds.
We recommend WeWe RSS"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" (WeChat Reading
based, free, self-hosted). Any agent on any machine can walk the user through:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Then:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"1. Open `http://127.0.0.1:4100/dash` and enter the auth code;
2. Add a WeChat Reading account (QR lo"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"gin — a separate system from the
official-account console);
3. Subscribe accounts with any article l"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ink `https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/...`
(the UI accepts links directly; `platform.getMpInfo` + `feed.ad"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"d` work too);
4. Each account feed looks like
`http://127.0.0.1:4100/feeds/<MP_WXS_xxx>.atom?auth_co"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"de=<code>&limit=20`;
5. Register it in the panel's source manager, or call
`wechat_collector_sources"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"(action=add, sourceType="rss_feed", url=...)`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"RSS items enter the pool as `wechat_article`; `wechat_collector_items` and
`import_to_studio` treat "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"both water sources identically. `auth_code` in feed
URLs is always masked in panel and tool output."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Creator analysis"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The panel stores the API key through DSH credentials under the
`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` reference. Plugin "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"settings and reports never contain the key.
The built-in analysis skills cover full author methodolo"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"gy, topic/title focus,
and structure/expression focus."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Analysis runs only after an explicit account-level action. At most 6,000
characters per article and "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"60,000 characters total are sent to the configured
DeepSeek-compatible endpoint. Reports stay under
"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"`~/.local/share/dsh-wechat-collector/analysis/reports` and are viewable in the
panel. Fewer than fiv"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"e substantial articles are always labelled as a small
sample."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Evidence and publishing boundary"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Collected previews are source leads, not verified facts, and not personal voice
